response_contract.message: The apparatus reports the deterministic source-defined statistic (e_i: Central value of the source-reported weighted-least-squares fit to ensemble-mean data.).

disclosed_modeling_choices: The Oracle exposes a deterministic analytic central fitted curve, not the paper's raw stochastic samples.
The paper's fit-parameter +/- values are retained as provenance but are not propagated into queried values because their statistical convention is not stated.
The world named counterfactual is the paper's real T=1 branch; it is counterfactual only relative to the registered historical T=10^-6 condition, not an invented law.
The query interval [100,1000] is a conservative common subset of the visible fitted curves, not a claim about the complete raw tau_Q sampling grid.
